Alert.description: Shows a persistent message inside the page, announced by urgency.

Alert.name: variant
Alert.description: Style and urgency. `destructive` uses role="alert"; `default` uses role="status".

Alert.name: children
Alert.description: An optional icon, then AlertTitle and AlertDescription.

AlertDialog.description: Asks the person to confirm before something irreversible or important happens, and waits for an answer.

AlertDialog.name: onOpenChange
AlertDialog.description: Runs when it opens, or closes through Cancel, the action or Esc.

AlertDialogTrigger.name: asChild
AlertDialogTrigger.description: Use your Button as the trigger.

AlertDialogContent.name: size
AlertDialogContent.description: sm: a narrow, centered confirmation with the two actions side by side.

AlertDialogContent.name: onEscapeKeyDown
AlertDialogContent.description: Esc cancels by default; prevent it only while an action is running.

AlertDialogDescription.name: children
AlertDialogDescription.description: What is lost and whether it can be undone.

AlertDialogMedia.name: children
AlertDialogMedia.description: An icon above the title (Heroicons Outline 24); decorative.

AlertDialogCancel.name: variant
AlertDialogCancel.description: Low emphasis. Receives focus when the dialog opens.

AlertDialogAction.name: onClick
AlertDialogAction.description: Runs the action, then the dialog closes.

AlertDialogAction.name: children
AlertDialogAction.description: Repeats the verb of the title, e.g. "Delete project".

Avatar.description: Shows a person's photo, with their initials as a fallback.

AvatarImage.name: alt
AvatarImage.description: The person's name, or "" when the name is written next to the avatar.

AvatarFallback.name: children
AvatarFallback.description: Two initials, shown while the image loads or when it fails.

AvatarBadge.name: children
AvatarBadge.description: A small status mark; give it a text alternative.

AvatarGroupCount.name: children
AvatarGroupCount.description: How many more people the group holds, e.g. "+3".

Badge.description: Labels a status or a category with one or two words.

Badge.name: variant
Badge.description: Visual style. Status variants always pair color with a word or symbol.

Badge.name: asChild
Badge.description: Renders its child (e.g. a link) with the badge style.

Button.description: Triggers an action on the current screen.

Button.name: variant
Button.description: Emphasis. Use one `default` button per area; `highlight` (yellow) and `emphasis` (red) at most once each, never for deletion.

Button.name: size
Button.description: Height from 24px to 40px; `icon` sizes are square and need `aria-label`.

Button.name: asChild
Button.description: Renders its child (e.g. a link) with the button style.

Button.name: disabled
Button.description: Removes the button from the tab order and blocks the action.

Button.name: onClick
Button.description: Runs on click, Enter and Space.

Button.name: children
Button.description: An optional icon, then a verb that says what happens.

Card.description: Groups content about one subject on a raised surface.

CardTitle.name: children
CardTitle.description: Short title; use a heading level that fits the page.

CardAction.name: children
CardAction.description: A control placed at the header's end.

CardFooter.name: children
CardFooter.description: Actions; the primary one goes last.

Checkbox.description: Turns an independent option on or off; the choice is saved with the form.

Checkbox.name: checked
Checkbox.description: Controlled state; `"indeterminate"` shows the mixed state.

Dialog.description: A window over the page for a short task that must be finished or canceled before going back.

Dialog.name: onOpenChange
Dialog.description: Runs when the dialog opens or closes (trigger, Esc, close button, outside click).

Dialog.name: modal
Dialog.description: Keeps the page behind inert and traps focus. Leave it on.

DialogTrigger.name: asChild
DialogTrigger.description: Use your Button as the trigger; it gets aria-haspopup and aria-expanded.

DialogContent.name: showCloseButton
DialogContent.description: Shows the corner close button. Keep a visible way to close.

DialogContent.name: closeLabel
DialogContent.description: Accessible name of the close button; translate it with the UI.

DialogContent.name: onInteractOutside
DialogContent.description: Call event.preventDefault() to keep the dialog open on outside clicks when data could be lost.

DialogContent.name: onCloseAutoFocus
DialogContent.description: Runs before focus returns to the trigger; prevent it only to send focus to a more useful place.

DialogTitle.name: children
DialogTitle.description: Names the dialog for screen readers. Every dialog has one.

DialogDescription.name: children
DialogDescription.description: Short context, announced after the title.

DialogFooter.name: showCloseButton
DialogFooter.description: Adds a ghost "Cancel" button that closes the dialog.

DialogClose.name: asChild
DialogClose.description: Use your Button to close the dialog.

DropdownMenu.description: A list of actions that opens from a button, for commands that don't fit on the screen at once.

DropdownMenu.name: onOpenChange
DropdownMenu.description: Runs when it opens or closes.

DropdownMenu.name: modal
DropdownMenu.description: While open, the page behind can't be scrolled or reached with the pointer.

DropdownMenuTrigger.name: asChild
DropdownMenuTrigger.description: Use your Button as the trigger; it gets aria-haspopup="menu" and aria-expanded. Don't give it your own id: the menu is named through the id the trigger is given.

DropdownMenuContent.name: sideOffset
DropdownMenuContent.description: Gap to the trigger, in px.

DropdownMenuContent.name: loop
DropdownMenuContent.description: Arrow keys wrap from the last item to the first.

DropdownMenuItem.name: onSelect
DropdownMenuItem.description: Runs the action; the menu then closes.

DropdownMenuItem.name: variant
DropdownMenuItem.description: Destructive items show in red and take the red highlight.

DropdownMenuItem.name: disabled
DropdownMenuItem.description: Shown dimmed and skipped by the arrow keys.

DropdownMenuItem.name: inset
DropdownMenuItem.description: Aligns an item without icon with items that have one.

DropdownMenuItem.name: textValue
DropdownMenuItem.description: Text for typeahead when the item's content isn't plain text.

DropdownMenuCheckboxItem.name: checked
DropdownMenuCheckboxItem.description: Exposed as aria-checked on a menuitemcheckbox.

DropdownMenuRadioGroup.name: onValueChange
DropdownMenuRadioGroup.description: Runs when another option is chosen.

DropdownMenuShortcut.name: children
DropdownMenuShortcut.description: The shortcut as shown, e.g. ⌘D. Wire the shortcut itself in your app.

DropdownMenuLabel.name: children
DropdownMenuLabel.description: Names the group below it; not focusable.

Field.description: Ties a label, instructions and an error message to one form control.

Field.name: required
Field.description: Adds `required` to the control; optional fields show "(optional)" in the label.

Field.name: invalid
Field.description: Set after validation finds a problem; shows FieldError and sets `aria-invalid`.

Field.name: controlId
Field.description: id given to the control. An id set on the control itself wins.

FieldControl.name: children
FieldControl.description: Exactly one control: Input, Textarea, PasswordInput or SelectTrigger.

FieldDescription.name: children
FieldDescription.description: Instructions, formats and limits, linked through `aria-describedby`.

FieldError.name: children
FieldError.description: What is wrong and how to fix it; rendered only while `invalid`.

Input.name: type
Input.description: Native type; picks the right mobile keyboard. Use PasswordInput for passwords.

Input.name: placeholder
Input.description: An example value; never a replacement for the label.

Label.description: Names a form control; clicking it focuses or toggles the control.

Label.name: htmlFor
Label.description: The id of the control it names.

PasswordInput.description: Password field with a button that shows or hides the characters.

PasswordInput.name: autoComplete
PasswordInput.description: Signing in or creating a password.

PasswordInput.name: showLabel
PasswordInput.description: Button text while the password is hidden.

PasswordInput.name: hideLabel
PasswordInput.description: Button text while the password is visible.

Popover.description: Shows extra content or a few quick controls next to the button that opened it, without leaving the page.

Popover.name: onOpenChange
Popover.description: Runs when it opens or closes (trigger, Esc, outside click, PopoverClose).

PopoverTrigger.name: asChild
PopoverTrigger.description: Use your Button as the trigger; it gets aria-haspopup and aria-expanded.

PopoverContent.name: side
PopoverContent.description: Preferred side; it flips when there is no room.

PopoverContent.name: sideOffset
PopoverContent.description: Gap to the trigger, in px.

PopoverContent.name: onOpenAutoFocus
PopoverContent.description: Focus moves into the popover on open; prevent it only to focus a specific field yourself.

PopoverTitle.name: children
PopoverTitle.description: Repeats what the trigger said would open.

PopoverClose.name: asChild
PopoverClose.description: Use your Button to close the popover; focus returns to the trigger.

Progress.description: Shows how far an operation has gone, or that it is still running when the total isn't known.

Progress.name: value
Progress.description: From 0 to max. Leave it out (or null) when the total is unknown: the bar becomes indeterminate.

Progress.name: max
Progress.description: The total the value is measured against.

Progress.name: aria-labelledby
Progress.description: Id of the visible label naming the operation. Use this or aria-label.

Progress.name: aria-label
Progress.description: Name of the operation when there is no visible label.

Progress.name: getValueLabel
Progress.description: Text read for the value; defaults to a percentage.

RadioGroup.description: Picks exactly one option from a short list where every option stays visible.
RadioGroup.anatomy: Delivery speed

RadioGroup.name: defaultValue
RadioGroup.description: Initial value when uncontrolled; leave it out to start with none selected.

RadioGroup.name: onValueChange
RadioGroup.description: Runs when the selection changes (click, tap, arrows, Space).

RadioGroup.name: aria-labelledby
RadioGroup.description: Id of the visible question that names the group (or aria-label).

RadioGroup.name: orientation
RadioGroup.description: Layout; arrow keys work in both directions either way.

RadioGroup.name: required
RadioGroup.description: One option must be chosen before submitting.

RadioGroup.name: aria-invalid
RadioGroup.description: Set after validation finds a problem; the options take the destructive border.

RadioGroupItem.name: id
RadioGroupItem.description: Ties the option to its Label (htmlFor).

Select.description: Picks one option from a compact list.

Select.name: onValueChange
Select.description: Runs when an option is chosen.

Select.name: required
Select.description: A value is needed to submit.

SelectValue.name: placeholder
SelectValue.description: Shown before a value is chosen.

Separator.description: A thin line between groups of content.

Separator.name: decorative
Separator.description: Hidden from screen readers. Set `false` only when the line is the only boundary between groups.

Skeleton.description: A placeholder shaped like content that is still loading.

Skeleton.name: className
Skeleton.description: Size and shape, e.g. "h-4 w-40" or "size-10 rounded-full".

Spinner.description: A small turning icon for a short wait of unknown length, inside a button, a row or next to a message.

Spinner.name: label
Spinner.description: Names the wait for screen readers. Say what is loading.

Spinner.name: aria-hidden
Spinner.description: Hide it when visible text next to it already names the wait.

Spinner.name: className
Spinner.description: Size (size-4, size-6) and color (text-muted-foreground) through tokens.

Switch.description: Turns a setting on or off immediately.

Table.description: Shows data compared across rows and columns.

Table.name: label
Table.description: Names the scrolling region for screen readers when the table scrolls sideways.

TableCaption.name: children
TableCaption.description: What the data is. Always include one.

Tabs.description: Switches between views of the same context.

Tabs.name: onValueChange
Tabs.description: Runs when the active tab changes.

Tabs.name: activationMode
Tabs.description: Automatic opens the panel as arrows move (recommended).

Textarea.name: placeholder
Textarea.description: An example value; never a replacement for the label.

Textarea.name: rows
Textarea.description: Visible lines; the field also grows with its content.

Textarea.name: maxLength
Textarea.description: Character limit; state it before the person types.

Toast.description: A short message about the result of an action, shown in a corner without interrupting the task. Built on Sonner.
Toast.anatomy:
<Toaster />

toast("Changes saved", {
  description,
  action: { label: "Undo", onClick },
})

Toaster.name: position
Toaster.description: Corner where toasts stack. Keep it clear of the main actions and the on-screen keyboard.

Toaster.name: duration
Toaster.description: Milliseconds before a toast leaves; the timer pauses on hover and focus.

Toaster.name: closeButton
Toaster.description: Adds a named close button to every toast.

Toaster.name: hotkey
Toaster.description: Moves focus to the notifications region.

toast().name: message
toast().description: One short sentence: what happened ("Changes saved").

toast().name: action
toast().description: One follow-up, such as Undo. Give the toast a longer duration.

toast().name: duration
toast().description: Overrides the Toaster duration for this message; Infinity keeps it until closed.

toast.success / info / warning / error.name: message
toast.success / info / warning / error.description: Adds the status icon; the words still say what happened.

toast.promise.name: promise
toast.promise.description: Shows loading, then success or error, in the same toast.

Tooltip.description: Shows the name of a control, usually an icon-only button, while the pointer rests on it or it has keyboard focus.

TooltipProvider.name: delayDuration
TooltipProvider.description: Milliseconds before a tooltip opens on hover. Focus opens it at once.

TooltipProvider.name: children
TooltipProvider.description: Your app, or the part of it that uses tooltips.

Tooltip.name: open
Tooltip.description: Controlled open state; leave it uncontrolled in most cases.

Tooltip.name: onOpenChange
Tooltip.description: Runs when it shows or hides.

TooltipTrigger.name: asChild
TooltipTrigger.description: Use your control as the trigger; it gets aria-describedby while the tooltip shows.

TooltipContent.name: children
TooltipContent.description: A few words naming the control, the same as its aria-label.

TooltipContent.name: side
TooltipContent.description: Preferred side; it flips when there is no room.

TooltipContent.name: sideOffset
TooltipContent.description: Gap to the control, in px.
